handoff_instructions: Re-applied the previous run's wip patch (workflow/wip/M2-T19.patch) via `git apply --3way`, which took cleanly file-by-file, then regenerated pnpm-lock.yaml from scratch instead of trusting the patch's lockfile hunk (it had unrelated eslint-plugin-import resolution churn). Implemented: packages/domain receptionist-config.ts (RECEPTIONIST_CONFIG_RULE_ACTION business_rules row schema); packages/core services/receptionist.ts (resolveReceptionistConfig: provider_routes -> organization -> active receptionist.config business rule, or unknown_number/missing_config with an ops case); packages/agents receptionist/prompt.ts additions (receptionistGreeting, RECEPTIONIST_FALLBACK_MESSAGE/PROMPT); packages/integrations AssistantTurn/AssistantToolDescriptor + VoiceProvider.buildAssistantResponse (Vapi + fake implementations); packages/workflows receptionist-runtime.ts (resolveAssistantTurn, wired through webhook-processor.ts + apps/web voice route/webhook-route.ts as a new answerSynchronousEvent hook so Vapi's assistant-request gets its reply inline instead of via the background job). Fixed 3 real bugs found while validating the carried-over work (none were pre-existing on main): (1) receptionist-runtime.ts used z.toJSONSchema on tool input schemas that contain .transform (email/phone normalizers) which zod v4 refuses to represent -- added `unrepresentable: "any"` since this JSON Schema only guides the model's function call, the domain schema still validates server-side; (2) webhook-processor.ts's assistantRequestAnswered handler attached an informational `note`, which the existing completeWebhookEvent always stores in last_error even for a `processed` result -- dropped the note so a successful synchronous answer leaves last_error null, consistent with the other processed handlers; (3) the new ingestion.test.ts case for tool-calls/transfer-destination-request built a Vapi payload with no `phoneNumber` field, so it resolved to `unroutable` instead of the intended `ignored` -- added the routed phoneNumber fixture field. All checks pass: pnpm format:check, pnpm lint, pnpm typecheck, pnpm test (includes packages/workflows/test/receptionist-runtime.test.ts and packages/core/test/receptionist.test.ts, which cover the fixture assistant-request producing a valid in-process assistant turn, the unknown-number fallback, and the missing-config fallback with its ops case). Every changed file is well under the 150-line step guidance. Next: M2-T20 (tool-calls handler) and M2-T21 (transfer-destination-request), which the receptionist-runtime.ts scaffolding and webhook-processor.ts handler map already anticipate.
